name: TVHeadend Fail-Fast
description: Provides live TV using TVHeadend as the source. Fork of the official plugin that stays responsive when the TVHeadend server is unreachable.
overview: TVHeadend plugin fork that fails fast when the server is unreachable

versions.changelog:
- Connection lifecycle reworked after upstream review: one background loop owns each connection, stale callbacks cannot affect a replacement connection, shutdown or connection loss wakes every pending request
- A brief TVHeadend restart is now invisible: the reconnect is immediate and callers wait for it; retries against a server that is really down never block the UI
- Rejected credentials are retried once the server, username or password in the configuration change (no restart needed); a stalled initial sync or a server that stopped answering triggers a reconnect
- Playback right after a TVHeadend restart waits for the reconnect instead of failing; the configuration is re-read on every reconnect attempt

- Fix a guide refresh while TVHeadend is unreachable deleting all channels and EPG data from Jellyfin: the plugin now reports an error instead of an empty channel list, so existing data is kept
- Rejected credentials stop the reconnect loop for good, with a clear error in the log (unreachable servers keep being retried with backoff)
- A connection closed by the server is rebuilt on the next call; keepalive tuning failures no longer prevent connecting; the reconnect loop stops when the plugin is unloaded

- Jellyfin 12 support: rebased on the official plugin version 15 (HTSP handling fixes across TVHeadend versions, series timers via autorec entries, web root taken from the server)
- Fail-fast connection handling, the unnumbered-channels option and the configuration page fixes carried over from 13.1.x

- Channels without a channel number (TVHeadend reports 0) are no longer dropped; new option "Include channels without a channel number" (default on)
- Fix the "channel type for Other" setting being ignored

- Fix the plugin configuration page: it requested the configuration of the upstream plugin GUID, got 404 and stayed on the loading spinner forever
- Configuration page now reports load/save errors instead of spinning silently

- Fail fast when the TVH server is unreachable: connection runs in a background loop with a 10s connect timeout and exponential backoff, UI requests never block on a dead server
- TCP keepalive detects a silently dead peer (e.g. VPN link down) within ~90s
- Do not cache failed playback ticket requests (playback stayed broken after TVH recovered)
- Based on the official plugin version 13
